scope: Verification-only RSA and ECDSA primitives and their shared must-use mathematical outcome. Independent Python oracles and external reference suites provide evidence separately from PDF document-signature conformance.

clauses: Mathematical validity, malformed input, strength policy and trust are separate
requirements.gaps: RSA and ECDSA return Result<Verification>; Valid and Invalid are must-use outcomes. Malformed inputs and exhausted budgets return Err. No trust, revocation, time or PDF revision validation is claimed.

tests: tools/signature_vectors.py sha (cached CAVP suites, exported from the private cache)
requirements.gaps: Byte-aligned messages only. SHA-1 is available for historical mathematical verification and fails the separate strength policy. Full CAVP suites use the external pinned cache; a public-domain minimized subset is bundled.

Verification-only arithmetic on public data, variable-time; no signing or private-key operations. Keys require canonical unsigned components, odd n > 1 and odd 3 <= e < n. Primality and proper key generation are not established.

Strict DER DigestInfo with NULL parameters, exact width and at least eight FF bytes. SHA-1/224/256/384/512 only; BER and absent-NULL Wycheproof acceptable cases are deliberately rejected. Full Wycheproof/CAVP/ACVP suites require the external pinned cache. ACVP SHA3/SHAKE RSA-PSS cases are explicitly unsupported, not counted as passes.

Resolved parameters support MGF1, trailer field 1, exact salt lengths including zero, and distinct message/MGF hashes. ASN.1 parameter decoding and enforcement of PSS key restrictions belong to PKI. Unsupported hash families are reported separately. Recovered encoding mismatches are Invalid, not Syntax errors.

clauses: Per-operation resource budgets and verification-only primitives
requirements.gaps: Limits exposes rsa_modulus_bits (default 16384), rsa_exponent_bits (256), rsa_work (64000000 radix-2^64 limb products, including Montgomery reduction); RsaLimits adapts these fields. Key setup is bounded by modulus width. ECDSA uses fixed per-call bounds (nine limbs, 521 scalar bits, bounded SEC1/DER). Hosts must separately bound total key and verification counts; no shared global signature-work accounting is claimed.

Prehashed ECDSA on P-256/P-384/P-521 only; digest selection and computation are caller-owned. Truncation uses leftmost order-sized bits, including P-521. Both high and low s are accepted. Full NIST/Wycheproof vectors use the external pinned cache, exported by tools/signature_vectors.py; the independent Python affine and arithmetic oracles are committed fixtures and always run.

Finite canonical SEC1 compressed/uncompressed points with in-range coordinates on the named curve are required. Cofactor one and prime group order make a separate n*Q check redundant for these three curves. Identity, hybrid, off-curve, wrong-width and trailing encodings are rejected.

clauses: RFC 3279 2.2.3; X.690 DER lengths and INTEGER encoding
requirements.gaps: Exactly two minimally encoded positive INTEGERs with 1 <= r,s < n are required; indefinite/nonminimal lengths, trailing data and oversized encodings are rejected. Wycheproof acceptable BER/legacy cases are deliberately rejected; IEEE P1363 is not this API.
